technical.title: Geometry-Aware Token Selection uses LiDAR and radar to optimize autonomous driving vision models
technical.summary: Geometry-Aware Token Selection leverages 3D point projections to select driving-critical image tokens before the vision backbone runs, discarding irrelevant background data.
technical.why: It improves efficiency and planning performance in sparse latent world models.

technical.title: TinyAstral transfers self-evolving harnesses to compact robotic manipulation agents
technical.summary: TinyAstral uses recursive self-improvement with frontier LLMs to refine a teacher's harness, then transfers the optimized harness and trajectories to a smaller agent.
technical.why: It enables smaller robotic agents to inherit advanced planning logic with lower compute costs.

technical.title: CalibSwitch framework recovers and maintains camera-LiDAR extrinsics for mobile robots
technical.summary: CalibSwitch separates absolute extrinsic recovery from selective state maintenance using bidirectional feature interaction and geometry-regularized learning from sensor observations.
technical.why: It ensures robust multimodal perception despite installation variations and changing observation quality.

technical.title: Direct Manifold Action Transformer models bimanual manipulation actions directly
technical.summary: DMAT reformulates action generation by directly modeling clean observation-conditioned joint-space action chunks, avoiding iterative denoising latency.
technical.why: It offers a faster and more robust alternative to diffusion policies in visuomotor control.

technical.title: DeepSeek open-sources dsh-superagent router-worker coding agent for parallel tasks
technical.summary: DeepSeek released dsh-superagent under the MIT license, turning GitHub and Feishu requests into parallel worker sessions to reduce task completion time.
technical.why: It provides a blueprint for efficient agentic software engineering workflows.

technical.title: NVIDIA releases Auto Ontology to ground AI agent SQL queries
technical.summary: Auto Ontology is an Apache 2.0 library that generates a semantic layer from enterprise metadata, grounding agent SQL in certified definitions and serving context via MCP, CLI, and API.
technical.why: It helps enterprise developers reliably connect AI agents to internal databases.

technical.title: Edge AI tools enable real-time application development for driver and cabin monitoring
technical.summary: Developers are utilizing edge AI capabilities to build applications that monitor driver attention and cabin conditions using compact commands.
technical.why: It highlights practical deployment patterns for computer vision in automotive edge environments.

technical.title: VoxLock target-speaker extraction model improves voice agent speech recognition accuracy
technical.summary: A fine-tuned causal target-speaker extraction model uses a voice sample from the call itself to filter background speech, achieving a low word error rate on benchmarks.
technical.why: It removes background noise for voice agents without requiring a separate enrollment step.

technical.title: Drone-PUR dataset and benchmark improve vision-language model reasoning in UAV scenes
technical.summary: Drone-PUR targets perception, understanding, and reasoning challenges in UAV scenes involving small targets, subtle attributes, and changing viewpoints.
technical.why: It helps address limitations of vision-language models under complex aerial observations.

technical.title: Nace AI open-sources Drex Max v1 multimodal decision model for Apple Silicon
technical.summary: Drex Max v1 is a 27B multimodal decision model scoring 67.52 that has been open-sourced to run locally on Apple Silicon.
technical.why: It expands local deployment options for large multimodal decision architectures.

business.title: South Korea targets sovereign AI with record new budget
business.summary: South Korea's 2027 budget will rise 12.8% to 820.9 trillion won, including a 21.3 trillion won investment into semiconductors, physical AI and AI data centers.
business.why: Massive state backing for physical AI and infrastructure signals strong market demand for hardware and data center engineering.

business.title: Physical AI leads top weekly venture funding rounds
business.summary: Manufacturing startup Re:Build closed on $2.1 billion and predictions marketplace Kalshi picked up $1 billion in a robust funding week.
business.why: Points to heavy capital deployment specifically targeting physical AI and manufacturing automation sectors.

business.title: Companies report AI revenue boosts and cost cuts
business.summary: Santander, Novartis and other companies say AI is beginning to boost revenue, cut costs or improve profitability as investors seek returns.
business.why: Proves tangible business value and enterprise adoption beyond experimental phases.

business.title: OpenAI pares fundraising goal to $20 billion
business.summary: OpenAI is now seeking up to $20 billion in its latest funding round, which is still in progress and subject to change.
business.why: Shifts in funding targets affect massive compute investments and GPU procurement scales.

business.title: Nvidia weighs cosigning Nscale AI data center loan
business.summary: Nvidia is considering playing the cosigner for Nscale's AI data center in West Virginia to ease investor nervousness about AI spending.
business.why: Highlights novel hardware vendor financing strategies for massive infrastructure builds.

business.title: The agentic web arrives for autonomous software navigation
business.summary: Tim Berners-Lee's 2001 vision of the Semantic Web outlines an internet designed to be navigated by autonomous software agents.
business.why: Autonomous agent deployment shifts architectural requirements for web applications and computer vision integrations.

business.title: Starbucks explores personalized digital menus at drive-thrus
business.summary: Starbucks CEO Brian Niccol announced plans to explore experiences recognizing customers at arrival with personalized digital menus.
business.why: Shows edge AI, computer vision, and personalization deploying directly into physical retail environments.

business.title: Meta's Muse agents could upend multiple businesses
business.summary: Companies have spent weeks reassuring investors that Muse and other AI agents pose more opportunity than threat.
business.why: Agentic workflows and automation tools threaten traditional business models while opening new software frontiers.

business.title: Anthropic expected to receive high junk rating
business.summary: Blackstone forecasts Anthropic will receive a high junk rating from credit agencies following an IPO, making capital raising costlier.
business.why: Financing costs dictate the long-term sustainability of foundational model development and infrastructure scaling.

business.title: Travel tech funding hits multiyear low despite AI
business.summary: Investor appetite for travel tech startups has cooled to a multiyear low despite a wave of startups promising AI improvements.
business.why: Illustrates uneven venture capital distribution where AI applications do not guarantee funding across all verticals.

models.title: Mistral Large 4 introduces a 1-trillion-parameter natively multimodal Mixture-of-Experts architecture
models.summary: Mistral Large 4 is a 1-trillion-parameter natively multimodal Mixture-of-Experts model with 49 billion active parameters per token. It unifies instruction following, reasoning, coding, and agent workflows while excelling at visual grounding.
models.why: It provides a massive open-weight model option surpassing frontier closed models on visual grounding.

models.title: Idol converts single images into 3D Gaussian splats rapidly
models.summary: Idol is a model that turns a single picture, render, or generated image into a 3D Gaussian splat containing up to a million Gaussians. It runs on consumer GPUs using 7.2 GB of VRAM in under 2 seconds.
models.why: It accelerates 3D asset generation directly from single 2D images for computer vision pipelines.

models.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 improves reasoning, coding, and visual benchmarks
models.summary: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 is a minor update delivering substantial improvements in reasoning, coding, agentic tasks, and visual benchmarks while reducing execution time and output length.
models.why: It advances the performance-cost Pareto frontier for agent harnesses.

models.title: LiquidAI releases LFM3-1.7B, a tri-hybrid text model for edge agents
models.summary: LFM3-1.7B is a text model for local agents built on a new tri-hybrid architecture. It features a 256K-token context window, fits into about 1 GB of memory at 4-bit precision, and supports single-GPU fine-tuning.
models.why: It enables efficient local agent deployment on edge devices like phones and laptops.

models.title: Qwen releases weights and configuration files for Qwen3.8-27B
models.summary: The Qwen3.8-27B repository contains model weights and configuration files compatible with Hugging Face Transformers, vLLM, SGLang, and TokenSpeed, with a managed cloud API featuring a 1M context length coming soon.
models.why: It offers a scalable 27B model option optimized for modern inference engines.

models.title: Qwen-Image-2.1 Uncensored Quantized formats released for local generation
models.summary: This repository provides GGUF, Safetensors, and MLX quantized formats of Qwen-Image-2.1 for local image generation using ComfyUI, including recommended configurations like Q4_K_M and MLX for Apple Silicon.
models.why: It enables localized, optimized image generation workflows across diverse hardware architectures.
